newsitem.title: USA: Insteel sees loss on disposal of unit.
newsitem.headline: Insteel sees loss on disposal of unit.

text.p: Insteel Industries Inc said Thursday it plans to sell its Insteel Construction Systems division, which manufactures and markets the Insteel 3-D building panel, and it expects to report a loss from the disposal of the business of $2.2 million, or $0.26 a share, in its second fiscal quarter ending March 31, 1997.
Insteel Industries produces concrete reinforcing products, industrial wire, agricultural fencing, nails and the Insteel 3-D building panel. The company operates plants in seven states and Mexico.
